generation_prompt: The robot uses its right hand to grasp the Rubik's cube between its thumb and fingers on the bottom shelf, lifts it clear, and carries it upward to the top shelf. It lowers the cube onto the top shelf and opens its hand, leaving the cube resting there with the right hand still nearby. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: The cube rests upright on the elevated top shelf with its white marked face upward and red face toward the robot. The right hand is open and adjacent to the cube, with no withdrawal shown. The bottom shelf is empty and the left hand remains open away from the shelf.

arm_hand_roles.right: Only manipulating hand: thumb and fingers grasp opposite sides of the cube, lift it from the bottom shelf, move it upward, lower it onto the top shelf and open to release. The hand stays close to the cube at the ending.
arm_hand_roles.left: Open and idle over the left side of the table throughout; does not stabilize the shelf, grasp the cube or assist the right hand.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand manipulation with no transfer or bilateral coordination. The early human adjustment moves the shelf only, before the robotic grasp.

uncertainties: The near thumb partly occludes the cube at the ending, so a very light residual touch cannot be excluded; the fingers are visibly open and the cube is supported by the top shelf.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
